facts.fact: La Nation reports the government set up three digital classrooms for visually impaired learners (Cotonou-Sègbèya, Parakou, and one other) with screen readers, braille printers and braille displays, and 31 pupils of CEG Sègbèya trained at Sègbèya in 2023-2024.
facts.system: Classes numériques pour personnes handicapées visuelles
